findings.evidence: Range build: `pkg/util/ranger/points.go:332-363` caps `KindUint64>MaxInt64` to `MaxInt64`, then `ConvertToMysqlYear()` clamps to 2155 and for `ast.GE` clears error without tightening the op; GE range construction is `[value,+inf]` at `pkg/util/ranger/points.go:456-459`. Runtime compare: YEAR-vs-INT refining only applies when `AdjustYear(... )` returns nil (`pkg/expression/builtin_compare.go:1639-1652`), so out-of-range uint64 (GetInt64() wraps negative) is not adjusted; comparison uses unsigned flags (`pkg/expression/builtin_compare.go:2862-2880`, `pkg/types/compare.go:90-110`) making `year_val >= huge_uint` always false. Access conds are not reserved as filters for YEAR comparisons (e.g. `filterConds: []` in `pkg/util/ranger/ranger_test.go:937-963`), so an over-wide GE range can leak extra rows.
findings.fix: In `refineValueAndOp` YEAR handling, when `ErrWarnDataOutOfRange` and the converted YEAR value differs from `preValue`, also refine inclusive ops to keep ranges exact: if `op==ast.GE` and `value.GetInt64() < preValue` then set `op=ast.GT`; if `op==ast.LE` and `value.GetInt64() > preValue` then set `op=ast.LT`. Add regression tests covering `YEAR >= <out-of-range-uint64>` with an existing 2155 row (expect empty).
findings.impact: Potential wrong results: `YEAR_col >= <out-of-range-uint64>` (or `<out-of-range-uint64> <= YEAR_col`) can produce a non-empty index range starting at 2155 and return rows with YEAR=2155 even though the executor-level predicate is unsatisfiable; affects primary key / index access conditions where the predicate is detached and not rechecked.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked later history up to `remotes/upstream/master`; `remotes/upstream/master:pkg/util/ranger/points.go` still contains the same out-of-range uint64 capping and the `case ast.GE, ast.LE: err = nil` handling (no GE->GT / LE->LT tightening), so this is not fixed later.
findings.verify: Add a planner/executor test: create `year` PK with a 2155 row and run `select * from t where y >= 16212511333665770580` (expect empty); also verify `<`/`<=` cases still return all rows (e.g. the new `TestIssue50235`) and that the access condition is not retained as a filter in the plan/explain for the GE case.
findings.what: YEAR range building change can make `YEAR_col >= out-of-range-uint64` return wrong results: the new cap-to-`MaxInt64` avoids overflow but, for `>=`, leads to a clamped YEAR constant (2155) with no operator tightening, yielding range `[2155,+inf)` while the executor comparison against the real unsigned constant is always false.

subject: planner: fix the wrong result caused by `year_col cmp out-of-range-uint` (#53395)
summary: Changes ranger YEAR comparison handling by capping out-of-range `uint64` constants to `math.MaxInt64` before YEAR conversion, and adds `TestIssue50235` for `<` with an out-of-range unsigned literal. Found a Blocker: for `>=` comparisons with out-of-range unsigned literals, the new path can build a non-empty range starting at YEAR=2155 while the runtime predicate remains unsatisfiable, risking wrong query results.
